market_need_then: Large personal injury market; tool vendors raised large rounds in 2025 and 2026, showing demand for AI in the field.

outcome_analysis: Wingman Law is a Fall 2026 AI native personal injury firm with a lawyer led founding team. No funding or case results are public, and a trade article notes no published outcome data. The model competes for cases against established firms and depends on legal marketing and operations more than software.
